description: Lookups, availability and booking cancellation stay free. Each agent identity gets 50 free tasks per UTC calendar month; then a delivered message costs 1 credit and a confirmed booking 5 credits. 1 credit = $0.10. Direct 100: 100 credits for $10; Direct 1,000: 1,000 credits for $90; Direct 10,000: 10,000 credits for $800. Credits never expire; nothing renews. Failed, refused and unconfirmed tasks cost nothing. Existing prepaid dollar balances keep their full cent value; 10 cents of balance equals 1 credit. Price quotes, paying a quoted price and agent-to-agent voice are not available. Send take_message, check_availability, book, book_first_available or cancel_booking. Cancellation requires data.booking_id and data.cancel_token from the confirmed booking, plus optional reason (up to 300 characters); it is free, uses no monthly allowance and does not refund the booking fee. Keep message_id unchanged on retry. Use target=claim for verified listings. Booking requires the human’s permission; pending deposits are charged only after calendar confirmation.
